reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators define a hierarchical probabilistic model where slate definition constrains the search space, salary corrobation provides confidence bounds, and internal data inventory enables multi-source fusion. The framework operates under dualities: (1) verification vs corrobation, (2) breadth-first search vs adversarial refinement, and (3) static slate definition vs dynamic player availability. Failure modes include API denial leading to unverified salaries, adversarial reports overturning prior inferences, and inconsistent data sources causing misalignment. These dualities are resolved through Bayesian updating and consensus mapping across lanes.
